raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "9.7.4"
  major_minor: "${{ (version | split('.'))[:2] | join('.') }}"

recipe:
  name: mysql-suite
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://cdn.mysql.com/Downloads/MySQL-${{ major_minor }}/mysql-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9188eb1abec42b8ab8bb69948492f06258dd27e6aabd13e2d4c6197dbcde75b2
  patches:
    - patches/0001-Make-installation-of-pdb-files-optional.patch
    - patches/0002-Fix-file-path-for-mysqlrouter.conf.sample-for-instal.patch
    - patches/0003-Allow-flags-other-than-macros-in-CPPFLAGS.patch
    - patches/0004-Add-include-header-for-std-string.patch
    - patches/0005-Remove-forceful-injection-of-debug-info.patch
    - patches/0006-Link-libgcc-libstdc-statically-for-codgen-binaries.patch
    - patches/0007-Add-dependency-on-comp_err-iff-that-target-exists.patch
    - patches/0008-Add-constructor-s-for-ut-Location.patch
    - patches/0009-Reduce-number-of-symbols-being-exported-from-mysqld..patch
    - patches/0010-Ensure-sql_main-uses-protobuf-shared-library-correct.patch
    - patches/0011-Include-missing-header-for-std-isdigit.patch
    - patches/0012-Print-number-of-lines-in-the-file-generated-by-creat.patch
    - patches/0013-Check-for-ARMv8-crc32-intrinsic-support-on-osx-arm64.patch
    - patches/0014-Revert-Bug-30981914-COMPILE-WITH-FASTER-TLS-MODEL.patch
    - patches/0015-Zlib-module-use-macro-instead-of-function.patch
    - patches/0016-Make-get_relative_path-binary-patching-friendly.patch
    - patches/0017-Make-libfido-checks-conditional.patch
    - patches/0018-Don-t-include-headers-from-Homebrew.patch
    - patches/0019-Use-config-mode-search-for-protobuf-first.patch
    - patches/0020-Simplify-protobuf-deps-using-cmake-alias.patch
    - patches/0021-Set-PROTOBUF_INCLUDE_DIR-only-if-not-set.patch
    - patches/0022-Allow-setting-WITH_SASL-none.patch
    - patches/0023-Dump-std-out-err-if-abi-check-fails.patch
    - patches/0024-Add-missing-cstdlib-includes.patch

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: mysql-build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - if: unix
          then: bison
        - if: unix
          then: diffutils
        - if: win
          then: winflexbison
        - if: linux
          then: binutils
        - pkg-config
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: icu
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: libprotobuf
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: openssl
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: zlib
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: zstd
      host:
        - icu
        - libabseil
        - if: unix
          then: libedit
        - libprotobuf
        - libcurl
        - lz4-c
        - if: unix
          then: openldap
        - openssl
        - zlib
        - zstd
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: build.sh
        - if: win
          then: build.bat

  - package:
      name: mysql-server
    inherit:
      from: mysql-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Server -P ${SRC_DIR}/build/cmake_install.cmake
        - if: unix
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Server_Scripts -P ${SRC_DIR}/build/cmake_install.cmake
        - if: unix
          then: ln -s ${PREFIX}/mysql/support-files/mysql.server ${PREFIX}/bin/mysql.server
        - if: win
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Server -P %SRC_DIR%\build\cmake_install.cmake
        - if: win
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Server_Scripts -P %SRC_DIR%\build\cmake_install.cmake
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - icu
        - libabseil
        - libcurl
        - libprotobuf
        - lz4-c
        - if: unix
          then: openldap
        - openssl
        - zlib
        - zstd
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-common', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-common', exact=True) }}
      # Used only for lber.h, no library needed at runtime
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - openldap
    tests:
      - script:
          - mysqld --version
          - if: unix
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/plugin/mysql_no_login.so
          - if: win
            then: if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\plugin\mysql_no_login.dll exit 1
    about:
      license_file: LICENSE
      license: GPL-2.0-or-later
      summary: Database server and related tools

  - package:
      name: mysql-client
    inherit:
      from: mysql-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Client -P ${SRC_DIR}/build/cmake_install.cmake
        - if: win
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Client -P %SRC_DIR%\build\cmake_install.cmake
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - if: unix
          then: libedit
        - libprotobuf
        - libcurl
        - openssl
        - zlib
        - zstd
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-common', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-common', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - mysql --version
          - mysqldump --version
          - if: unix
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/plugin/mysql_native_password.so
          - if: win
            then: if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\plugin\mysql_native_password.dll exit 1
    about:
      license_file: LICENSE
      license: GPL-2.0-or-later
      summary: MySQL client applications and tools

  - package:
      name: mysql-devel
    inherit:
      from: mysql-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Development -P ${SRC_DIR}/build/cmake_install.cmake
        - if: win
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Development -P %SRC_DIR%\build\cmake_install.cmake
        - if: linux
          then: sed -i 's,zlib,z,g' ${PREFIX}/bin/mysql_config
        - if: osx
          then: sed -i '' -e 's,zlib,z,g' ${PREFIX}/bin/mysql_config
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        # 2022/03/20 hmaarrfk
        # Add openssl to ensure a unique build number fo mysql-devel
        - openssl
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-libs', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-libs', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        # https://mysqlserverteam.com/the-client-library-part-2-the-version-number/
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-libs', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then: test -f $PREFIX/include/mysql/mysql.h
          - if: unix
            then: test -f $PREFIX/include/mysql/mysqlx_version.h
          - if: unix
            then: test -f $PREFIX/lib/pkgconfig/mysqlclient.pc
          - if: win
            then: if not exist %LIBRARY_INC%\mysql\mysql.h exit 1
          - if: win
            then: if not exist %LIBRARY_INC%\mysql\mysqlx_version.h exit 1
          - if: win
            then: if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\mysqlclient.lib exit 1
          - if: unix
            then: mysql_config --version
          - if: unix
            then: mysql_config --libs
    about:
      license_file: LICENSE
      license: GPL-2.0-or-later
      summary: Development header files and libraries for MySQL database client applications

  - package:
      name: mysql-libs
    inherit:
      from: mysql-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=SharedLibraries -P ${SRC_DIR}/build/cmake_install.cmake
        - if: win
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=SharedLibraries -P %SRC_DIR%/build/cmake_install.cmake
        - if: win
          then: move %LIBRARY_LIB%\*.dll %LIBRARY_BIN%\
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - openssl
        - zlib
        - zstd
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-common', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-common', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libmysqlclient${SHLIB_EXT}
          - if: win
            then: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libmysql.dll exit 1
    about:
      license_file: LICENSE
      license: GPL-2.0-or-later
      summary: Shared libraries for MySQL database client applications

  - package:
      name: mysql-common
    inherit:
      from: mysql-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: cmake -P ${SRC_DIR}/build/share/cmake_install.cmake
        - if: win
          then: cmake -P %SRC_DIR%\build\share\cmake_install.cmake
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        # 2022/03/20 hmaarrfk
        # Add openssl to ensure a unique build number fo mysql-devel
        - openssl
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then: test -f $PREFIX/share/mysql/english/errmsg.sys
          - if: unix
            then: test -f $PREFIX/share/mysql/charsets/ascii.xml
          - if: win
            then: if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\mysql\english\errmsg.sys exit 1
          - if: win
            then: if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\mysql\charsets\ascii.xml exit 1
    about:
      license_file: LICENSE
      license: GPL-2.0-or-later
      summary: Common files for server and client libraries

  - package:
      name: mysql-router
    inherit:
      from: mysql-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      # Requires macOS >=10.12
      skip:
        - osx
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Router -P ${SRC_DIR}/build/cmake_install.cmake
        - if: win
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Router -P %SRC_DIR%\build\cmake_install.cmake
        - if: win
          then: move %LIBRARY_LIB%\*.dll %LIBRARY_BIN%\
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - icu
        - libprotobuf
        - lz4-c
        - openssl
        - zlib
        - zstd
    tests:
      - script:
          - mysqlrouter --version
          - if: unix
            then: test -f $PREFIX/lib/mysqlrouter/http_auth_backend.so
          - if: win
            then: test -f %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\mysqlrouter_http.dll
    about:
      license_file: LICENSE
      license: GPL-2.0-or-later
      summary: MySQL Router binaries

  - package:
      name: mysql
    inherit:
      from: mysql-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Documentation -P ${SRC_DIR}/build/cmake_install.cmake
        - if: unix
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Info -P ${SRC_DIR}/build/cmake_install.cmake
        - if: unix
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=ManPages -P ${SRC_DIR}/build/cmake_install.cmake
        - if: unix
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Readme -P ${SRC_DIR}/build/cmake_install.cmake
        - if: unix
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=SupportFiles -P ${SRC_DIR}/build/cmake_install.cmake
        - if: win
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Documentation -P %SRC_DIR%\build\cmake_install.cmake
        - if: win
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Info -P %SRC_DIR%\build\cmake_install.cmake
        - if: win
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=Readme -P %SRC_DIR%\build\cmake_install.cmake
        - if: win
          then: cmake -DCOMPONENT=SupportFiles -P %SRC_DIR%\build\cmake_install.cmake
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        # 2022/03/20 hmaarrfk
        # Add openssl to ensure a unique build number fo mysql-devel
        - openssl
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-server', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-client', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-devel', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-libs', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mysql-common', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then: test -f $PREFIX/share/man/man1/mysql.1
          - if: unix
            then: test -f $PREFIX/share/man/man8/mysqld.8
          - if: unix
            then: mysql_config --version
          - my_print_defaults --version
          - mysqld --help --verbose
          - if: unix
            then: command -v mysql.server
    about:
      license_file: LICENSE
      license: GPL-2.0-or-later
      summary: Meta package for backwards compat + bonus content

about:
  homepage: https://www.mysql.com/
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Open source relational database management system.
  description: |
    The MySQL(TM) software delivers a very fast, multi-threaded, multi-user,
    and robust SQL (Structured Query Language) database server. MySQL Server
    is intended for mission-critical, heavy-load production systems as well
    as for embedding into mass-deployed software.
